title: crossandra infundibuliformis subsp. crocea
intro: Crossandra infundibuliformis subsp. crocea, commonly known as the Yellow Crossandra, is a tropical plant species belonging to the Acanthaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Crossandra involve its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
